Rationale: About 18% of booked places are no-shows.

Requirement: Members book classes without calling or visiting the front desk.
Release 1 offers class booking on the website; a mobile app follows later.
The mobile app comes first; the website follows.
Members can book a class online and cancel it up to 1 hour before it starts.
When a class is full, members can join a waitlist and are moved in automatically when a place frees up.
Members receive a reminder 24 hours before the class.
Trainers see the list of booked members for their class.
Cancellations later than 1 hour before the class count as a no-show.
A member on the waitlist must accept a freed place within 30 minutes; otherwise it goes to the next person.
No-shows in the pilot clubs fall below 10% within 3 months of launch.
The booking service is available 99.5% of the time during club opening hours.
